name: Eurasian oystercatcher
desc: Uses its strong bill to open cockles and mussels or to dig up worms. Despite its name, oysters are not a major food.
about: The Eurasian oystercatcher or European oystercatcher, also known as the common pied oystercatcher, or (in Europe) just oystercatcher, is a wader in the oystercatcher bird family Haematopodidae.
